title: Clariant puts hybrid sun care innovation in the spotlight at in-cosmetics Asia
summary: Clariant has unveiled three new personal care ingredients at the in-cosmetics Asia trade show, which took place November 3-5 in Bangkok, Thailand. The manufacturer of personal care ingredients exhibited a portfolio of innovations addressing key formulation challenges in sun care, skin care and cleansing. Led by Eclipsogen CAP Duo Z, a ready-to-use hybrid UV filter dispersion designed to simplify the formulation of high-protection sunscreens, the showcase also featured new cleansing... - Industry buzz

products.name: Eclipsogen CAP Duo Z
products.launch_quote: The main launch, Eclipsogen CAP Duo Z, is a ready-to-use dispersion combining three organic UV filters (DHHB, EHT and BEMT) with zinc oxide in a single system containing 38.5% total UV filter actives.

products.name: Sensotain ILS
products.launch_quote: Clariant also introduced Sensotain ILS , a multifunctional emollient designed for complex sun care and skin care formulations.

products.name: GlucoTain Pro P
products.launch_quote: In cleansing, the company presented GlucoTain Pro P , an ultra-mild foam booster designed to generate abundant foam even in the presence of oils.

products.name: GlucoTain Sense
products.launch_quote: The GlucoTain portfolio also includes GlucoTain Sense , a palm-free sensory additive made from European sunflower oil and glucose.

products.name: AlgaSurge
products.launch_quote: At in-cosmetics Asia , Lucas Meyer Cosmetics by Clariant highlighted AlgaSurge , a skin longevity active featuring vegan polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN) derived from red microalgae.
